Yash Nair
Senior Data Analyst | Secunderabad
yash.nair797@example.com | +91 9873516597 | Open to relocation anywhere in India

Versatile data analyst with a strong foundation in analytical tools and stakeholder-facing reporting. Experienced in transforming large transactional datasets into actionable insights, automating recurring reports and driving metric-based decisions. Communicates findings clearly to cross-functional teams and partners to improve operational efficiency and product outcomes.

Experience
Paystack India — Apr 2026 - Present
Data Analyst
- Built and maintained Power BI dashboards tracking payment success rates, chargeback incidence and merchant cohort performance; dashboards reduced ad-hoc report requests by 45% and enabled identification of a 3.2% weekly payment-success uplift after remediation.
- Performed end-to-end ETL and SQL analysis on transaction and reconciliation datasets to detect anomalies; wrote optimized SQL queries that reduced query runtime by 60% and uncovered a reconciliation gap worth ~₹1.8M.
- Automated monthly executive reports in Microsoft Excel and Power BI combining pivot models and DAX measures; automation cut report preparation time from 3 days to under 6 hours and improved accuracy of KPIs.
- Partnered with product and operations teams to prototype Python3/pandas analyses for A/B experiments and dispute resolution workflows, producing clear Confluence documentation for handoff.

Projects
- Merchant Churn Predictor: Used SQL and Python3 (pandas) to create a churn scoring model for high-value merchants; deployed model outputs into Power BI for daily monitoring and prioritized outreach lists for operations.
- Reconciliation Automation Toolkit: Developed a set of Excel templates and SQL scripts to standardize settlement reconciliation processes, decreasing manual adjustments by 35%.

Skills
Languages: SQL, Python3
Stack: Power BI, Microsoft Excel, pandas
Tools & Collaboration: Confluence, Git, Linux

Education
B.Tech, Computer Science, VIT Vellore

Notice period: 15 days
